JYM-GIT-STASH(1)                Git Manual               JYM-GIT-STASH(1)

NAME
       jym-git-stash - Stash the changes in a dirty working directory away

SYNOPSIS
       jym-git stash list [<options>]
       jym-git stash show [<options>] [<stash>]
       jym-git stash drop [-q|--quiet] [<stash>]
       jym-git stash ( pop | apply ) [--index] [<stash>]
       jym-git stash push [<options>] [--] [<pathspec>...]
       jym-git stash clear

DESCRIPTION
       Use jym-git stash when you want to record the current state of the
       working directory and the index, but want to go back to a clean
       working directory.

COMMANDS
       The subcommands below manipulate the stash stack. Each entry
       refers to a previously stashed state.

       push
           Save your local modifications to a new stash entry.

       list
           List the stash entries that you currently have.

       show
           Show the changes recorded in the stash entry.

       pop
           Remove a single stash entry and apply it on top of the current
           working tree state.

       apply
           Like pop, but do not remove the state from the stash list.

       drop
           Remove a single stash entry from the list of stash entries.

       clear
           Remove all the stash entries.

SEE ALSO
       jym-git-checkout(1), jym-git-commit(1)
